name: Grade 6 T3 Summative: Spreadsheet Vocabulary
description: Ten core third-trimester words for the Grade 6 spreadsheet summative vocabulary table.

words.definition: A digital table used to organize and calculate information.
words.example: We used a spreadsheet for class data.

words.definition: Facts or values that can be collected.
Data that has meaning or is useful.
words.example: The chart turned data into information.

words.definition: A line of cells that goes across a table.
words.example: One row showed one student response.

words.definition: A line of cells that goes down a table.
words.example: The column listed the item costs.

words.definition: One box in a spreadsheet table.
Information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table showed items and prices.

words.definition: A label at the top of a column or section.
A rule or calculation used by a spreadsheet.
A visual way to show data.
